title: IMRT treatment planning
description: IMRT treatment planning is an outpatient appointment series that prepares you for radiation therapy by mapping the exact radiation dose for your tumor. Your radiation oncologist and medical physicists create a customized plan using imaging and computer calculations. You'll undergo CT scans and possibly other imaging while positioned exactly as you'll be during treatment. The planning process takes several appointments and may take 1-2 weeks. Once planning is complete, your actual radiation treatments begin. This category includes different levels of complexity based on your tumor characteristics. The cost of this procedure may vary depending on the complexity involved. Categories include basic consultation & dosimetry, device/hardware, and complex dosimetry.

contents.description: Treatment devices, design and construction; Complex (irregular blocks, special shields, compensators, wedges, molds or casts)
